description: This file contains unit tests for client-addressable objects in an Orleans-based distributed system. It tests various scenarios including method invocation, error propagation, pull model data exchange, and stress testing for concurrency and state management.

classes.name: ClientAddressableTests
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying client-addressable object interactions in Orleans, including method calls, error handling, pull model, and stress tests.

classes.name: MyPseudoGrain
classes.description: Mock implementation of a client-side object that grains can call methods on, demonstrating success, error, and concurrency scenarios.

classes.name: MyProducer
classes.description: Mock implementation of a client-side producer that grains can poll for data, demonstrating the pull model.

methods.name: TestClientAddressableHappyPath
methods.description: Tests successful invocation of a client object method from a grain.

methods.name: TestClientAddressableSadPath
methods.description: Tests error propagation from client object method back to the grain.

methods.name: GrainShouldSuccessfullyPullFromClientObject
methods.description: Verifies grains can pull data from a client-side producer object.

methods.name: MicroClientAddressableSerialStressTest
methods.description: Stress test for serial execution of client object method calls.

methods.name: MicroClientAddressableParallelStressTest
methods.description: Stress test for parallel execution of client object method calls.
